title: Naengmyeon with Buckwheat Noodles
description: A refreshing Korean summer dish made with buckwheat naengmyeon noodles, chilled buckwheat noodles, and a sweet and spicy sauce.
instructions: Cook the buckwheat naengmyeon noodles according to package instructions.
In a separate pot, cook the chilled buckwheat noodles according to package instructions.
In a large bowl, whisk together the gochujang sauce, sesame oil, and soy sauce.
Add the cooked buckwheat naengmyeon noodles to the bowl and toss to coat with the sauce.
Add the cooked chilled buckwheat noodles to the bowl and toss to combine.
Garnish with sliced green onions and roasted sesame seeds.
